payload.text: ADD-03 3.1 says: 'Form 4-G (Cybersecurity Compliance Undertaking), added by Addendum No. 2 Section 7, is withdrawn. Bidders shall disregard it and shall not submit it. Section 7.2 of Addendum No. 2 ceases to have effect.' The proposed op ADD-03/3.1(a) revokes only ADD-02:7.2. Row ADD-02-7.2-01 is therefore REVOKED and needs no new reading. Two things stay ACTIVE at ADD-03: the form itself (ADD-02:F4-G, meaning undertakings 1-6 and the signature line) and its entry in the Envelope A list (VOL-I:9.1(e)+ADD-02, 'FORM 4-G — CYBERSECURITY COMPLIANCE UNDERTAKING'). They stay active because the op engine cannot revoke the form as a group, and it rejects the form's member units as targets the provision does not name (dry run, C22). A person needs to decide: (1) whether rows ADD-02-F4G-01 to -05, and any rows on undertakings 5 and 6, stop applying from ADD-03; (2) whether the ADD-02 item list of row VOL-I-9.1-01, which includes Form 4-G, should be re-read without it; (3) whether evidence item EV-FORM-4G and A5 activities form-4g-review and form-4g-sign should come off the programme; (4) whether issues I-F4G-NO and I-F4G-LETTERING lapse. Those two issues were accepted only under an interview_demo assumption, which acknowledges them and nothing more. No handling instruction is recorded for any of these points, and none is inferred. The interview_demo 'changed' review status of the Form 4-G rows is kept as it is.

items.model_rationale: I read ADD-03:3.1 with get_unit (text layer, so no crop), and read the ADD-02:F4-G group and VOL-I:9.1(e)+ADD-02 at ADD-03. I dry-ran set_status ops on the group, on one member row and on the list insertion. The obligation words of row ADD-02-7.2-01 appear only in ADD-02:7.2, which is now revoked as a whole unit, so a reading with 'removed' does not apply and none is proposed.

payload.why: software limitation: ADD-03:3.1 withdraws Form 4-G ('is withdrawn ... shall not submit it'), but the only op the engine can represent is set_status on ADD-02:7.2. The row's second unit, VOL-I:9.1(e)+ADD-02 ('FORM 4-G — CYBERSECURITY COMPLIANCE UNDERTAKING'), stays active. set_status on that unit fails C22 ('not cited; the provision cites [ADD-02:F4-G, ADD-02:S7, ADD-02:7.2]'), and set_status on the cited group ADD-02:F4-G fails C22 because a group is not a unit. Row ADD-02-7.2-01 is REVOKED through ADD-02:7.2 and needs no reading. The leftover Envelope A entry is recorded in issue I-ADD03-F4G-SCOPE for a person to decide.
payload.what_is_unsupported: Revoking a whole form that an earlier addendum inserted (a group the provision cites), together with the list entry that inserted it. set_status accepts only a single named unit that the provision cites.

payload.why: software limitation: the row's unit ADD-02:F4-G/T1/3 is an undertaking in Form 4-G. ADD-03:3.1 says the form 'is withdrawn' and that 'Bidders shall ... not submit' it. No op can revoke this unit: set_status on ADD-02:F4-G/T1/3 fails C22 ('is a row of cited ADD-02:F4-G, but the provision does not name it'). So the unit stays active and the row shows as ACTIVE and STALE. A re-made reading at ADD-03 quoting 'A named accountable security officer will be appointed for the concession period.' would show an undertaking from a withdrawn form as in force. A 'removed' reading is not available because no op deleted these words. No reading is proposed. A person decides whether the row stops applying from ADD-03 (issue I-ADD03-F4G-SCOPE). The review status 'changed' (interview_demo) is kept as it is.
